title: Advanced Business Anomaly 3D Realtime Tracker

architecture.title: 3D Realtime Business Anomaly Tracker — architectural blueprint
architecture.note: Research blueprint hard-coded against this checkout. Aspirational stack names stay narrative; runtime uses fixtures, public stubs, and closest installs.

systemOverview.function: Real-time ingestion from business registries, financial systems, social media, and public records
systemOverview.shipped: Firecrawl MCP (optional key) + EDGAR/OFAC/FINRA REST stubs + data/anomaly/fixtures.json
systemOverview.note: No Kafka/Debezium cluster. No Dun & Bradstreet scrape.

systemOverview.function: Anomaly detection, pattern recognition, and P1 event classification
systemOverview.shipped: server/anomaly-tracker.ts deterministic P1/P2/P3 classifier over hard-coded fixtures
systemOverview.note: In-process TypeScript. Flink/Streamz are not installed.

systemOverview.function: 3D geospatial rendering of business entities, anomalies, and threat vectors
systemOverview.shipped: CSS perspective scene on /tracker (fixture city lat/lon)
systemOverview.note: No Mapbox token or Deck.gl dependency. Coordinates are fixtures.

systemOverview.function: Immutable storage of all evidence with chain-of-custody hashing
systemOverview.shipped: Postgres MCP placeholder + MiniSearch in-process ES substitute + fixture hash narratives
systemOverview.note: No TimescaleDB. Docker ES falls back when daemon absent.

systemOverview.function: Semantic analysis of communications, legal reasoning, and threat scoring
systemOverview.shipped: local-v1 / local-v1-concise + FOLIO MCP + CourtListener stub + POST /v1/legal/search
systemOverview.note: Scores company-held / public text only. No intercept corpus.

systemOverview.function: Autonomous agent workflows for continuous scanning and alerting
systemOverview.note: Does not invent unpublished MCP packages. Continuous field scanning is fixture rehearsal.

systemOverview.function: Zero-trust access, policy enforcement, and audit logging
systemOverview.shipped: server/policy.ts + .env placeholders + CJIS always-403 + wrangler dry-run only
systemOverview.note: No HashiCorp Vault, OPA, or Istio mesh in this studio.

dataFlow.title: Ingest
dataFlow.proposed: Pull business registry data (Secretary of State, EDGAR, Dun & Bradstreet) via Firecrawl MCP and public APIs.
dataFlow.shipped: EDGAR stub + Firecrawl MCP optional + fixture entity roster

dataFlow.title: Enrich
dataFlow.proposed: Cross-reference with OFAC sanctions, FINRA TRACE, and PACER litigation records.
dataFlow.shipped: OFAC/FINRA stubs + pacer-client placeholder (no CM/ECF session)

dataFlow.title: Monitor
dataFlow.proposed: Continuously scan business communications (email, VoIP, WeChat, Slack) via intercept APIs (where legally authorized).
dataFlow.shipped: Slack MCP reads a company workspace token only when set. No VoIP/WeChat intercept.

dataFlow.title: Detect
dataFlow.proposed: Apply FBI indicators (CFAA, money laundering, FCPA, RICO) to flag P1 anomalies.
dataFlow.shipped: Hard-coded typology labels on fixtures + corporate taxonomy doctrine cues. Not a live FBI feed.

dataFlow.title: Visualize
dataFlow.proposed: Render 3D geospatial map with entity nodes, anomaly heatmaps, and real-time alert feeds.
dataFlow.shipped: /tracker CSS 3D nodes + P1 pulse + event queue tick

dataFlow.title: Escalate
dataFlow.proposed: Automatically generate SARs, CISA notifications, and law-enforcement liaison reports.
dataFlow.shipped: Counsel checklists and doctrine search only. No SAR/CISA auto-filing from this process.

layers.title: Verified ingest

layers.title: Taxonomy cross-reference

layers.title: Guardrails
